Park Gate Primary School Curriculum Statement A Curriculum for Life: Knowledge, Skills and Values for the Future At Park Gate Primary School, we have designed a rich, ambitious and enjoyable curriculum for all children.
Our curriculum is underpinned by the National Curriculum, sequenced progressively to build key knowledge, skills, and vocabulary across all subjects.

Spiritual, Moral, Social and Cultural (SMSC) Development We believe that a high quality curriculum should help children understand the world and their place within it.

We also ensure that children understand the role of trusted adults and their trust teams, both in school and within the wider community, and the importance of speaking to professionals who are there to help keep them safe.

We promote collaboration and community mindedness by encouraging children to work with others, to take care of their environment led by our Eco Warriors, and to develop the skills to resolve conflicts in constructive and respectful ways led by our School council and House Captains.

Curriculum Overview
How do we organise our curriculum?
To help our children to understand the learning behaviours expected at Park Gate we have the Park Gate Values in Action. These values are woven into our curriculum teaching so that children can develop an understanding of how to be the best learner possible and achieve their very best.
